vs-CNP000067.name: Myeongdong
vs-CNP000067.summary: Myeongdong is Seoul's shopping mecca and is a must-see for tourists, but it is not just a shopping destination; it's a hub of commerce, banking, and culture.

vs-CNP015338.name: 1898 Myeongdong Cathedral
vs-CNP015338.summary: 1898 Myeongdong Cathedral is a complex cultural space frequented by many people and was built as a place that would facilitate communication and sharing.

vs-CNP000061.name: Dongdaemun Market
vs-CNP000061.summary: Dongdaemun Market is a large commercial district comprised of traditional markets and shopping centers that covers the entire area around Dongdaemun Gate, a prominent landmark in Korea.

vs-CNP024679.name: Dongdaemun Design Plaza (DDP)
vs-CNP024679.openingHours: 10:00-20:00 KST (Vary by space, see the website)
vs-CNP024679.summary: Dongdaemun Design Plaza opened its door on 21st March 2014. DDP is running 24 hours a day and functioning as an open space for public.

vs-CNP002077.name: Itaewon
vs-CNP002077.summary: Located smack-dab in the center of Seoul, Itaewon is home for the majority of expats that reside in Korea, making Itaewon a mini melting pot of cultures and religions from all over the world.

vs-CNP2ts0gq.name: Hongdae Mural Street
vs-CNP2ts0gq.summary: A street where you come across art by chance while walking through Hongdae

vs-CNP000286.name: Gwangjang Market
vs-CNP000286.summary: Gwangjang Market is one of Korea's largest traditional markets and is renowned for its quality silk goods, linen bedding and hand-made goods.

vs-CNPouf85a.name: Seongsu Pedestrian Overpass
vs-CNPouf85a.summary: A place where you can enjoy a wonderful sunset and night view in Seongsu

vs-CNPnj8f9x.name: COEX K-POP Square
vs-CNPnj8f9x.summary: A landmark destination with giant outdoor screens reminiscent of Times Square

vs-CNP002220.name: Banpodaegyo Bridge Moonlight Rainbow Fountain
vs-CNP002220.summary: The world’s longest bridge fountain (recognized by the Guinness Book of World Records) with 380 water jets and a dazzling array of multi-colored lights.

vs-CNP012993.name: Yeouido Hangang Park
vs-CNP012993.summary: A park where you can enjoy various things to enjoy, such as cherry blossom festival in spring and water play in summer, and enjoy beautiful riverside

vs-CNP016328.name: Seokchon Lake at Night
vs-CNP016328.summary: Go to Seokchon Lake to see all 123 stories of the Lotte World Tower lit up like something out of a fairy tale.

vs-CNP000036.name: Namsan Seoul Tower
vs-CNP000036.summary: Namsan Seoul Tower was built in 1969 as Korea's first integrated transmission tower beaming television and radio broadcasts across the capital.

vs-CNP037008.name: Ikseon-dong Hanok Village
vs-CNP037008.summary: A famous yet romantic Seoul landmark located in the Jongno area with cozy alleyways that are steeped in Korean tradition in between hanoks.
